viewing_check: Find the maker's name on the ricasso (Wilkinson, Sanderson, Chapman, EFD etc.); check the scabbard leather and that it fits. Google Lens on photo 5 reads the 'Japanese-looking' marks as normal British inspection stamps (broad arrow, X bend test, inspector marks), so they are not a rare variant.
